mapper.select: select (select count(*) from item where status = 'ON_SALE') as onSaleCount, (select count(*) from item where status = 'SOLD') as soldCount, (select count(*) from `user` where role = 'USER' and status = 'ACTIVE') as certifiedUserCount, (select ifnull(sum(view_count), 0) from item) as totalViewCount
